run_js_file.brief: 独立运行一个 JS 脚本文件（开发辅助）/ Run a standalone JS script file (development helper)

params.path: 脚本文件路径 / Script file path
params.as_module: 按 ES 模块解析为 1，否则按脚本 / 1 to parse as an ES module, otherwise as a script

run_js_file.return: 成功返回 0，失败返回 1 / 0 on success, 1 on failure
run_js_file.note: 新建临时 JS 运行时，把脚本所在目录设为当前目录后求值，最后销毁运行时 / Creates a throwaway JS runtime, sets the script's directory as the current directory, evaluates, then destroys the runtime

put_u32.brief: 按小端写入 32 位整数 / Write a 32-bit integer little-endian

params.p: out:接收 4 字节的缓冲 / Buffer that receives the four bytes
params.v: 待写入的数值 / Value to write

put_u32.note: 供 BMP 文件头组装使用 / Used when assembling the BMP file header

write_bmp.brief: 把像素缓冲写成 32 位 BMP / Write a pixel buffer as a 32-bpp BMP

params.path: 输出文件路径 / Output file path
params.pm: 源像素缓冲 / Source pixel buffer

write_bmp.return: 写入成功返回 1，否则 0 / 1 on success, otherwise 0

retval.1: 文件已完整写出 / The file was fully written
retval.0: `pm` 无像素或文件无法打开 / `pm` has no pixels or the file could not be opened

write_bmp.note: BMP 行序自下而上，故逐行倒序写出 / BMP rows are stored bottom-up, so rows are written in reverse

app_refresh_title.brief: 把引擎状态同步到窗口标题 / Sync the engine status into the window title
app_refresh_title.note: 标题形如 `Hope - <状态>`，其中状态行承载加载错误等信息 / The title reads `Hope - <status>`, the status line carrying load errors and the like

app_paint.brief: 绘制一帧并提交给窗口 / Render a frame and present it to the window

params.user: 宿主回调透传的用户数据，此处为 `App *` / User data passed through by the host, an `App *` here

app_paint.note: 渲染引擎、取像素缓冲提交，再刷新标题；无窗口时直接返回 / Renders the engine, presents its pixmap, then refreshes the title; returns early without a window

app_resize.brief: 响应窗口尺寸变化 / Handle a window resize

params.user: `App *` 用户数据 / The `App *` user data
params.width: 新的客户区宽度 / New client width
params.height: 新的客户区高度 / New client height

app_resize.note: 调整引擎尺寸后请求重绘 / Resizes the engine then requests a repaint

app_scroll.brief: 响应滚轮滚动 / Handle wheel scrolling

params.user: `App *` 用户数据 / The `App *` user data
params.lines: 滚动行数（正负表示方向）/ Number of lines, sign gives the direction

app_scroll.note: 滚动引擎后请求重绘 / Scrolls the engine then requests a repaint

chrome_key_for_vk.brief: 把虚拟键码映射为地址栏编辑键 / Map a virtual key code to an address-bar editing key

params.vk: 虚拟键码 / Virtual key code

chrome_key_for_vk.return: 对应的 `HPE_KEY_*`，非编辑键返回 0 / The matching `HPE_KEY_*`, 0 when it is not an editing key

chrome_key_for_ctrl.brief: 把 Ctrl+字母映射为编辑快捷键 / Map a Ctrl+letter combo to an editing shortcut

params.vk: 虚拟键码（字母）/ Virtual key code (the letter)

chrome_key_for_ctrl.return: 对应的 `HPE_KEY_*`，非快捷键返回 0 / The matching `HPE_KEY_*`, 0 when the combo is not a shortcut
chrome_key_for_ctrl.note: 识别 V/C/X/A 的粘贴、复制、剪切、全选 / Recognises paste, copy, cut and select-all on V/C/X/A

app_key.brief: 把键盘事件翻译成引擎按键 / Translate a keyboard event into an engine key

params.user: `App *` 用户数据 / The `App *` user data
params.vk: 虚拟键码 / Virtual key code

app_key.note: 先尝试 Ctrl 编辑快捷键再尝试普通编辑键；未消费时 F5 重载页面、Escape 关闭窗口 / Tries Ctrl editing shortcuts then plain editing keys; when unconsumed F5 reloads the page and Escape closes the window

app_char.brief: 把已输入字符送给地址栏 / Pass a typed character to the address bar

params.user: `App *` 用户数据 / The `App *` user data
params.codepoint: Unicode 码点 / Unicode code point

app_char.note: 引擎报告已消费时请求重绘 / Requests a repaint when the engine reports the key was consumed

app_mouse.brief: 把鼠标事件交给引擎 / Forward a mouse event to the engine

params.user: `App *` 用户数据 / The `App *` user data
params.x: 客户端 X 坐标 / Client X coordinate
params.y: 客户端 Y 坐标 / Client Y coordinate
params.button: 鼠标按键（0 左键，负数表示纯移动）/ Mouse button (0 = left, negative means a bare move)
params.down: 按下为 1、抬起为 0 / 1 when pressed, 0 when released

app_mouse.note: 按键为负时走移动路径，否则走按键路径；有变化才请求重绘 / Uses the move path for a negative button, the button path otherwise; repaints only on a change

app_tick.brief: 响应周期定时器 / Handle the periodic timer

params.user: `App *` 用户数据 / The `App *` user data

app_tick.note: 泵脚本定时器与 rAF 回调；有变化才请求重绘 / Drains script timers and rAF callbacks; repaints only on a change

print_usage.brief: 打印命令行用法 / Print the command-line usage
print_usage.note: 列出窗口尺寸、`--dump` 截图、`--bench`、`--scroll-lines`、`--chrome` 以及 `--js`/`--module` 脚本模式 / Lists window size, `--dump` screenshots, `--bench`, `--scroll-lines`, `--chrome` and the `--js`/`--module` script modes

parse_args.brief: 解析命令行参数 / Parse the command-line arguments

params.argv: 参数值数组 / Argument value array
params.o: out:接收解析结果的选项结构 / Options struct that receives the parsed settings

parse_args.return: 需要就此结束时返回进程退出码，继续运行返回 -1 / The process exit code when the run should stop here, -1 to continue
parse_args.note: `--js`/`--module` 会在解析期间直接运行脚本并以其退出码返回；无法识别的参数被当作待打开的文件路径 / `--js`/`--module` run a script immediately and return its exit code; an unrecognised argument is taken as the file path to open

load_start_document.brief: 加载启动文档并决定是否显示地址栏 / Load the start document and decide whether to show the address bar
load_start_document.note: 窗口模式总是显示地址栏；无头 `--dump` 模式默认只画页面，除非传了 `--chrome`，以保持像素基线稳定 / Window mode always shows the address bar; headless `--dump` stays page-only unless `--chrome` is passed, keeping pixel baselines stable

synth_click.brief: 合成一次鼠标点击 / Synthesise one mouse click
synth_click.note: 先移动指针再按下与抬起，模拟真实点击 / Moves the pointer first, then presses and releases, mimicking a real click

synth_drag.brief: 合成一次拖拽（按下、滑过、抬起）/ Synthesise a drag (press, walk over, release)

params.x1: 拖拽起点 X / Drag start X
params.x2: 拖拽终点 X / Drag end X
params.y: 拖拽 Y 坐标 / Drag Y coordinate

synth_drag.note: 中间分 6 步移动指针，像真人拖拽一样经过中间位置 / Walks the pointer over six intermediate steps so it looks like a human drag

key_named.brief: 把按键名解析为按键码与修饰键 / Resolve a key name into a key code and modifiers

params.name: 按键名，如 `LEFT`、`CTRL_C` / Key name such as `LEFT` or `CTRL_C`
params.key: out:接收 `HPE_KEY_*` 按键码 / Receives the `HPE_KEY_*` key code
params.mods: out:接收 `HPE_MOD_*` 修饰键掩码 / Receives the `HPE_MOD_*` modifier mask

key_named.return: 名称匹配返回 1，否则 0 / 1 when the name matched, otherwise 0
key_named.note: 内置一张固定名表，未匹配时不写出输出 / Looks up a fixed name table and writes nothing when there is no match

synth_type.brief: 把 UTF-8 字符串逐字符当作按键送入引擎 / Feed a UTF-8 string into the engine as individual key strokes

params.s: 要输入文本 / Text to type

synth_type.note: 按码点切分后逐个调用 `hpe_engine_key`，用于无头测试打字 / Splits by code point and calls `hpe_engine_key` per character, used for headless typing tests

hook_test_addr.brief: 测试钩子：像用户一样驱动地址栏导航 / Test hook: drive address-bar navigation like a user would
hook_test_addr.note: 读 `HOPE_TEST_ADDR` 作为输入；先点击条带聚焦，再打字，设置了 `HOPE_TEST_ADDR_ENTER` 时按回车 / Reads `HOPE_TEST_ADDR` for the input; clicks the strip to focus, types it, and presses Enter when `HOPE_TEST_ADDR_ENTER` is set

hook_test_clipboard.brief: 测试钩子：播种剪贴板后按 Ctrl+V 语义粘贴 / Test hook: seed the clipboard and paste with Ctrl+V semantics
hook_test_clipboard.note: `HOPE_TEST_CLIPBOARD` 提供剪贴板文本；设置了 `HOPE_TEST_PASTE` 时聚焦并粘贴，再按 `HOPE_TEST_PASTE_ENTER` 决定是否回车 / `HOPE_TEST_CLIPBOARD` supplies the clipboard text; with `HOPE_TEST_PASTE` set it focuses and pastes, pressing Enter when `HOPE_TEST_PASTE_ENTER` is set

hook_addr_click.brief: 测试钩子：按 `x[,mods]` 串点击地址栏 / Test hook: click the address bar from an `x[,mods]` string

params.click: 分号分隔的 `x[,mods]` 点击项 / Semicolon-separated `x[,mods]` click entries

hook_addr_click.note: 每项在地址栏纵向中心合成一次点击 / Synthesises one click at each entry on the address-bar vertical centre

hook_addr_dblclick.brief: 测试钩子：按 `x1[,x2]` 串连点两次选词 / Test hook: click twice from an `x1[,x2]` string to select a word
hook_addr_dblclick.note: 省略 `x2` 或为 0 时两次都点在 `x1` / Uses `x1` twice when `x2` is omitted or zero

hook_addr_drag.brief: 测试钩子：按 `x1,x2[,y]` 串合成拖选 / Test hook: drag-select from an `x1,x2[,y]` string
hook_addr_drag.note: 省略 `y` 时使用地址栏纵向中心 / Falls back to the address-bar vertical centre when `y` is omitted

hook_addr_keys.brief: 测试钩子：按分号串发送命名按键 / Test hook: send named key strokes from a semicolon-separated string

params.keys: 分号分隔的按键名，如 `LEFT;CTRL_C` / Semicolon-separated key names such as `LEFT;CTRL_C`

hook_addr_keys.note: 每个名字经 `key_named` 解析后带修饰键送入引擎 / Each name is resolved by `key_named` and sent to the engine with its modifiers

hook_test_addr_editor.brief: 测试钩子：驱动地址栏文本编辑器 / Test hook: drive the address-bar text editor
hook_test_addr_editor.note: 依次处理 `HOPE_TEST_ADDR_CLICK`、`HOPE_TEST_ADDR_DBLCLICK`、`HOPE_TEST_ADDR_DRAG`、`HOPE_TEST_TYPE`、`HOPE_TEST_KEYS` / Processes `HOPE_TEST_ADDR_CLICK`, `HOPE_TEST_ADDR_DBLCLICK`, `HOPE_TEST_ADDR_DRAG`, `HOPE_TEST_TYPE` and `HOPE_TEST_KEYS` in turn

hook_test_click_at.brief: 测试钩子：合成点击以驱动交互页面 / Test hook: synthesise clicks to drive interactive pages
hook_test_click_at.note: 读 `HOPE_TEST_CLICK_AT`，形如 `x,y[,button]`；用分号分隔多项，可让思维导图节点折叠或按钮触发 / Reads `HOPE_TEST_CLICK_AT` as `x,y[,button]`, semicolon-separated, so a mind-map node collapses or a button fires

report_addr_text.brief: 报告地址栏最终状态 / Report the final address-bar state
report_addr_text.note: 仅在设置了 `HOPE_TEST_ADDR_TEXT` 时输出文本、长度、选区、插入符与焦点 / Prints the text, length, selection, caret and focus only when `HOPE_TEST_ADDR_TEXT` is set

report_meta.brief: 报告加载时探测到的文档元数据 / Report document metadata detected at load time
report_meta.note: 仅在设置了 `HOPE_TEST_META` 时输出编码、`<meta charset>`、`<base href>` 以及逐条的 `<link>` 资源提示 / Prints the encoding, `<meta charset>`, `<base href>` and each `<link>` resource hint only when `HOPE_TEST_META` is set

run_headless.brief: 无头模式运行并可选导出截图 / Run headlessly and optionally export a screenshot
run_headless.note: 指定 `--scroll-lines` 时先整帧渲染再滚动，使滚动走脏矩形路径以成为真正的增量滚动测试；`--bench` 重复渲染并打印平均耗时；最后销毁引擎 / With `--scroll-lines` it renders a full frame first so the scroll goes through the damage-rect path and becomes a real incremental-scrolling test; `--bench` repeats rendering and prints the average; then the engine is destroyed

run_window.brief: 创建窗口并进入事件循环 / Create the window and enter the event loop
run_window.return: 成功返回 0，创建窗口失败返回 1 / 0 on success, 1 when window creation failed
run_window.note: 装配全部窗口回调后阻塞运行；循环返回后销毁窗口与引擎 / Wires up all window callbacks and blocks in the loop; destroys the window and engine afterwards

main.brief: 程序入口：解析参数并选择运行模式 / Program entry: parse arguments and pick the run mode

params.argv: 参数值数组 / Argument value array

main.return: 进程退出码 / The process exit code
main.note: 默认窗口 1000×700；创建引擎、加载启动文档、依次跑各测试钩子并汇报，然后按 `--dump`/`--bench` 走无头或窗口模式 / Defaults to a 1000×700 window; creates the engine, loads the start document, runs the test hooks and reports, then chooses headless or window mode based on `--dump`/`--bench`
